Aragonese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • salita

Etymology

[edit]

From salir +‎ -ida.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlida/
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧da
  • Rhymes: -ida

Noun

[edit]

salida f (plural salidas)

  1. exit
    Antonym: entrada

References

[edit]
  • Bal Palazios, Santiago (2002), “salida”, in Dizionario breu de a luenga aragonesa, Zaragoza, →ISBN

Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From salir +‎ -ida.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlida/ [saˈli.ð̞a]
  • Rhymes: -ida
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧da

Noun

[edit]

salida f (plural salíes)

  1. exit
    Antonym: entrada

Cebuano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish salida (“exit”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Hyphenation: sa‧li‧da
  • IPA(key): /saˈlida/ [s̪ɐˈl̪i.d̪ɐ]

Noun

[edit]

salida

  1. a television show; a live or recorded broadcast or program, or series of broadcasts or programs, meant to be viewed on television
  2. a film; a movie
    Synonym: pelikula

Verb

[edit]

salida

  1. to turn on the television (to watch a show or film)
  2. to air or broadcast (a program or film on television)
  3. to play (a video using a video player)

Central Bikol

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish salida (“exit”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlida/ [saˈl̪i.d̪a]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: sa‧li‧da

Noun

[edit]

salída (Basahan spelling ᜐᜎᜒᜇ)

  1. (rare) exit
    Synonym: luwasan

Verb

[edit]

salída (plural saralida, Basahan spelling ᜐᜎᜒᜇ)

  1. to replace, change
    Synonyms: ribay, sangli, bago
  2. to leave a station (as trains, buses, etc.)
    Synonym: hali

Derived terms

[edit]
  • kasalida
  • magsalida
  • pagsalida
  • salidahan

[edit]

Romanization

salida

  1. romanization of 𐍃𐌰𐌻𐌹𐌳𐌰

Spanish

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlida/ [saˈli.ð̞a]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ida
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧da

Noun

[edit]

salida f (plural salidas)

  1. exit, way out
    Synonym: exida
    Antonym: entrada
  2. departure
    Antonym: llegada
  3. future, future opportunity
    Synonym: porvenir
    un trabajo con salida ― a bright future
  4. (computing) output
    Synonym: output

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish salida.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /saˈlida/ [sɐˈliː.d̪ɐ]
  • Rhymes: -ida
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧da

Noun

[edit]

salida (Baybayin spelling ᜐᜎᜒᜇ)

  1. exit; way out
    Synonym: labasan
  2. departure; leaving
    Synonyms: pag-alis, pagyao, alis, yao
  3. downward slope or descent (of a road)
    Synonyms: lusong, paglusong
  4. rushing down a slope (of a vehicle, especially without the aid of an engine)
  5. professional call (especially of a doctor)
    Synonyms: dalaw, pagdalaw
  6. (by extension) fee for a professional call
    Synonym: subida
  7. expenditures
    Synonyms: gastos, gugol
  8. (gambling) money paid out to winners in excess of the winnings after each game
    Antonym: kabig
  9. (accounting) debit

Derived terms

[edit]
  • salidahan
  • salidahin
